nodes.name: mart_billing_accuracy
nodes.description: Billing accuracy by billing period month, territory, segment, rate category and tariff type: original bills, reversals, re-bills, accuracy rate, outsorting (and estimated-read share), billed and reversed amounts.

nodes.name: fct_meter_read
nodes.description: Stages 1-2. One row per meter read order (MRO, EABLD/EABL): MRU, read reason (01 periodic, 02 interim/move-in, 03 final), read type (AMI, MANUAL, CUSTOMER_SELF_READ, ESTIMATED), scheduled vs actual read date, status (SUCCESS, NO_ACCESS, DEVICE_FAILURE, COMMS_FAILURE), EL09 mass run, EL18 estimation run, and the VEE result: rules failed (zero usage, spike, negative/rollback, missing interval, out of window), first pass, routed to the EL28 manual exception queue, resolution (ACCEPTED, EDITED, RE_READ, ESTIMATED, PASSED) and hours to resolve.

nodes.name: fct_bpem_case
nodes.description: Stage 7. BPEM / EMMA clarification cases (BILLING outsorting, METER_READING implausible reads, PAYMENT clarification) with status, open flag, age and age bucket.

nodes.name: mart_cash_application
nodes.description: Cash application by receipt month, territory, payment channel and gateway: payments, auto-matched vs manual, posting lag, gateway reconciliation and remittances not yet posted to FI-CA.

nodes.name: fct_ar
nodes.description: Stage 7. FI-CA open items (DFKKOP, one per print document) with aging bucket, dunning level, clearing reason (PAYMENT, REVERSAL, WRITE_OFF, INSTALLMENT_PLAN), write-off (DFKKWO), payment arrangement (DFKKRP) and the payer's usual payment channel. Replaces fct_fica (all its columns kept).

nodes.name: mart_revenue_assurance
nodes.description: Monthly billed kWh vs metered kWh (periodic reads), outsorted bill rate, estimated-read share by territory and rate category. Reversed bills excluded (their re-bill counts).

nodes.name: mart_cycle_times
nodes.description: Cycle times by billing period month, territory and channel. CHANNEL_TYPE DELIVERY: read->bill, bill->invoice, bill->delivered, read->delivered (avg, p50, p90). CHANNEL_TYPE PAYMENT: invoice->payment days, on-time share and DSO for accounts whose usual payment channel it is.

nodes.name: mart_churn_risk
nodes.description: Per-contract churn risk score derived from missed payments, dunning history, consumption trend and upcoming move-out.

nodes.name: fct_payment
nodes.description: Stage 6. One row per FI-CA payment lot item (DFKKZP): channel (AUTOPAY, CARD, DIGITAL_WALLET, BANK_DRAFT, AGGREGATOR, LOCKBOX, CASH_AGENT), wallet brand and gateway from the payments gateway, received vs posted date, auto cash application vs manual clarification, gateway reconciliation, invoice cleared and invoice-to-payment days.

nodes.name: mart_vee
nodes.description: Meter reading and VEE by billing period month, territory, MRU and read type: read success and failure reasons, estimated reads, first pass, failures by rule, manual exception queue, resolutions and hours to resolve.

nodes.name: mart_theft_tamper
nodes.description: AMI tamper events by device with premise location, days flagged, estimated loss kWh and status.

nodes.name: mart_m2c_kpis
nodes.description: The 10 Meter-to-Cash KPIs by PERIOD_MONTH x TERRITORY_NAME x SEGMENT with numerators/denominators: METER_READ_SUCCESS_RATE, VEE_FIRST_PASS_RATE, READ_TO_BILL_DAYS (read -> bill delivered), BILLING_ACCURACY_RATE, EXCEPTION_RATE ((VEE manual exceptions + outsorted bills) / bills), INVOICE_TO_PAYMENT_DAYS, DSO_DAYS (average daily open AR / average daily billing of the last 91 days), AUTO_CASH_APPLICATION_RATE, WRITE_OFF_RATE, ARRANGEMENT_BREAKAGE_RATE.

nodes.name: fct_bill
nodes.description: Stages 3-5. One row per billing document (ERCH) incl. reversed bills and re-bills: rate-calculation lines aggregated (energy by tier block / TOU period, fixed charge, tax), outsorting, reversal, re-bill link, print document / invoice (ERDK), delivery channel and delivered date (customer engagement / print vendor), and cycle times read->bill created, bill->invoice, invoice->delivered, bill->delivered, read->delivered (the read-to-bill window). Replaces fct_billing (all its columns kept).

nodes.name: mart_collections
nodes.description: Collections by territory, segment, slot and posting month: arrears by aging bucket, dunning, payment rate, DSO, write-offs, payment arrangements (created, broken, completed, breakage %) and SMS reminders vs disconnect notices.

nodes.name: mart_source_coverage
nodes.description: Rows each selected source supplies per canonical object, plus the coverage gaps of the selected SAP systems.

nodes.name: mart_m2c_funnel
nodes.description: The 7 stages (Meter Reading, Validation (VEE), Rate Calculation, Bill Generation, Bill Delivery, Payment Collection, Exceptions & Collections) by billing period month and territory: entered, completed, dropped, completion rate.

nodes.name: mart_billing_exceptions
nodes.description: Outsorted original bills with exception type (estimated read, zero consumption, long period, other), days open, revenue at risk, days to release and the BPEM case.
